fields.statement: Built rhiza with go build -trimpath to a scratch path; rhiza guide check-plan, check-code and review print the merged plan rules, the code rules and an index naming check-plan, check-code, check-qa for a conductor run and the older four for the classic workflows; rhiza guide install --agent claude into a scratch HOME wrote skills/rhiza-check-plan/SKILL.md and skills/rhiza-check-code/SKILL.md beside check-compliance, check-quality and check-model (26 files), and a repeat install reported 26 unchanged; the acceptance tests pass.

With the built binary in a scratch repo: rhiza workflow check refuses an agent step's check with no name, a duplicate name, a bad name, or a prompt, and still refuses check on a command step and critic on an agent step; in a live run with a fake claude in an agent step declaring plan, code and qa, rhiza run findings --check plan/code/qa recorded each check's round, and --check scope exited 2 naming plan, code, qa.

With the built binary: rhiza run start --workflow ship-change --dry-run on a leafless change set is refused ('has no leaves', next run start --workflow plan) under a command-step ship-change and under one whose agent step with checks is not first, and would start under the conductor ship-change; rhiza daemon --once picks nothing under the builtin ship-change, but under the conductor ship-change it starts the leafless milestone-serving change set and skips a leafless one serving a non-milestone intent.

In live runs with a fake conductor, rhiza run review-check from the later gate step failed naming an unjudged blocker and a confirmed major, passed after a downgrade and a clean latest round, and refused a verdict on an unknown finding. But a run whose checks recorded no round passed the gate and succeeded (QA finding f1).

rhiza guide conduct and the installed skills/rhiza-conduct/SKILL.md name every phase and command. Following it with a fake agent, rhiza run spawn --role check-plan started the child, but the child had no RHIZA_CHECK or RHIZA_CYCLE, so its rhiza run findings --check "$RHIZA_CHECK" exited 2 (QA finding f2).
